note: 系列 A 例句軌 A2 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: Yesterday I walked to school with my friend.
items.zh: 昨天我和朋友走路去學校。

items.sentence: I am going to visit my grandma on Sunday.
items.zh: 我星期天要去看奶奶。

items.sentence: My brother is taller than me.
items.zh: 我哥哥比我高。

items.sentence: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
items.zh: 我很累，所以我早早就去睡了。

items.sentence: We bought some fruit at the market.
items.zh: 我們在市場買了一些水果。

items.sentence: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
items.zh: 我喜歡茶，但我不喜歡咖啡。

items.sentence: She is faster than her sister.
items.zh: 她跑得比她姊姊快。

items.sentence: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
items.zh: 外面在下雨，所以我們待在家裡。

items.sentence: I did my homework after dinner.
items.zh: 我晚餐後寫了功課。

items.sentence: We are going to watch a movie tonight.
items.zh: 我們今晚要看一部電影。

items.sentence: This book is more interesting than that one.
items.zh: 這本書比那本更有趣。

items.sentence: I cleaned my room this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上整理了房間。

items.sentence: My feet hurt because I walked a lot.
items.zh: 我的腳很痛，因為我走了很多路。

items.sentence: Can you help me find my keys?
items.zh: 你可以幫我找鑰匙嗎？

items.sentence: We played soccer in the park yesterday.
items.zh: 我們昨天在公園踢足球。

items.sentence: I want to buy a new bike.
items.zh: 我想買一台新腳踏車。

items.sentence: The weather is colder today than yesterday.
items.zh: 今天天氣比昨天更冷。

items.sentence: She sang a song at the party.
items.zh: 她在派對上唱了一首歌。

items.sentence: I am going to call my friend later.
items.zh: 我等一下要打電話給朋友。

items.sentence: My mom made a cake for my birthday.
items.zh: 我媽媽為我的生日做了一個蛋糕。

items.sentence: We can take the train to the city.
items.zh: 我們可以搭火車去市區。

items.sentence: I forgot my umbrella at home.
items.zh: 我把雨傘忘在家裡了。

items.sentence: He is good at drawing pictures.
items.zh: 他很會畫圖。

items.sentence: Turn left and the shop is there.
items.zh: 左轉，商店就在那裡。

items.sentence: I felt happy when I saw my dog.
items.zh: 看到我的狗時我覺得很開心。

items.sentence: We need to buy some milk and eggs.
items.zh: 我們需要買一些牛奶和雞蛋。

items.sentence: The test was easy, so I was happy.
items.zh: 考試很簡單，所以我很開心。

items.sentence: I usually get up early on weekends.
items.zh: 我週末通常很早起床。

items.sentence: My sister helped me with my homework.
items.zh: 我姊姊幫我做功課。

items.sentence: We went to the beach last summer.
items.zh: 我們去年夏天去了海邊。

items.sentence: I missed the bus this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上錯過了公車。

items.sentence: She is going to study English next year.
items.zh: 她明年要學英文。

items.sentence: This shirt is cheaper than that jacket.
items.zh: 這件襯衫比那件外套便宜。

items.sentence: We ate lunch at a new restaurant.
items.zh: 我們在一家新餐廳吃了午餐。

items.sentence: I want to learn, but I feel sleepy.
items.zh: 我想學習，但我覺得很想睡。

items.sentence: My dad cooked dinner for us last night.
items.zh: 我爸爸昨晚為我們煮了晚餐。

items.sentence: The park is bigger than my school.
items.zh: 這座公園比我的學校大。

items.sentence: I was scared, so I turned on the light.
items.zh: 我很害怕，所以我把燈打開了。

items.sentence: We are going to plant a tree today.
items.zh: 我們今天要種一棵樹。

items.sentence: She found her phone under the bed.
items.zh: 她在床底下找到了她的手機。

items.sentence: I like summer because the days are long.
items.zh: 我喜歡夏天，因為白天很長。

items.sentence: He washed the dishes after breakfast.
items.zh: 他吃完早餐後洗了碗。

items.sentence: The red bag is heavier than the blue one.
items.zh: 紅色的袋子比藍色的重。

items.sentence: I am going to wear my new shoes tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天要穿我的新鞋子。

items.sentence: We waited for the train for ten minutes.
items.zh: 我們等火車等了十分鐘。

items.sentence: My grandma told me a funny story.
items.zh: 我奶奶跟我講了一個好笑的故事。

items.sentence: Go straight and the bank is on the right.
items.zh: 直走，銀行就在右邊。

items.sentence: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
items.zh: 我很餓，所以我做了一個三明治。

items.sentence: This river is longer than that one.
items.zh: 這條河比那條長。

items.sentence: She is going to join the swimming club.
items.zh: 她要加入游泳社。

items.sentence: We planted flowers in the garden yesterday.
items.zh: 我們昨天在花園裡種了花。

items.sentence: I like this song, but it is too loud.
items.zh: 我喜歡這首歌，但它太大聲了。

items.sentence: He ran fast and won the race.
items.zh: 他跑得很快，贏得了比賽。

items.sentence: My room is smaller than my sister's room.
items.zh: 我的房間比我姊姊的房間小。

items.sentence: I am going to help my mom cook.
items.zh: 我要幫我媽媽煮飯。

items.sentence: We saw a big ship at the port.
items.zh: 我們在港口看到一艘大船。

items.sentence: She was late because the car was slow.
items.zh: 她遲到了，因為車子開得很慢。

items.sentence: I drank a glass of water after running.
items.zh: 跑完步後我喝了一杯水。

items.sentence: This box is lighter than it looks.
items.zh: 這個箱子比看起來輕。

items.sentence: We are going to paint the wall white.
items.zh: 我們要把牆漆成白色。

items.sentence: He opened the window because it was hot.
items.zh: 因為很熱，他把窗戶打開了。

items.sentence: I learned to ride a bike last week.
items.zh: 我上週學會了騎腳踏車。

items.sentence: The cake is sweeter than the bread.
items.zh: 蛋糕比麵包甜。

items.sentence: She is going to meet her friend at noon.
items.zh: 她中午要和朋友見面。

items.sentence: We climbed the hill and saw the sea.
items.zh: 我們爬上山丘，看到了大海。

items.sentence: I wanted to play, but it was raining.
items.zh: 我想玩，但那時在下雨。

items.sentence: My teacher gave us a short test today.
items.zh: 我的老師今天出了一個小考。

items.sentence: Take the second street on the left.
items.zh: 走左邊第二條街。

items.sentence: I felt sad when my friend moved away.
items.zh: 朋友搬走時我覺得很難過。

items.sentence: We need to wash our hands before we eat.
items.zh: 吃飯前我們要洗手。

items.sentence: The movie was long, but it was good.
items.zh: 這部電影很長，但很好看。

items.sentence: She usually reads a book before bed.
items.zh: 她睡前通常會看一本書。

items.sentence: My brother fixed my broken toy.
items.zh: 我哥哥修好了我壞掉的玩具。

items.sentence: We went shopping for new clothes on Saturday.
items.zh: 我們星期六去買了新衣服。

items.sentence: I am going to write a letter to my friend.
items.zh: 我要寫一封信給我的朋友。

items.sentence: The soup was hot, so I waited.
items.zh: 湯很燙，所以我等了一下。

items.sentence: He is stronger than his older brother.
items.zh: 他比他哥哥更強壯。

items.sentence: I lost my pencil, so I borrowed one.
items.zh: 我弄丟了鉛筆，所以我借了一枝。

items.sentence: We watched the stars in the night sky.
items.zh: 我們看著夜空裡的星星。

items.sentence: She smiled because she passed the test.
items.zh: 她笑了，因為她通過了考試。
